name: SVC_SELF_SERVICE_ROLES
description: This table is used to store self service roles created by users. ROLE_ID is primary / unique key in this table.

columns.name: ROLE_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_CD
columns.description: This column is stores relationship type System Look up

columns.name: REQUEST_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code for type of registration request. Possible values include B2B and B2C

columns.name: LOGIN_ID
columns.description: Login Id specified by the user to be used as userName of the ldap account, if not provided, the username would be determined by the profile option

columns.name: INITIAL_IDP_CD
columns.description: Name of the Initial Identity Provider where this self service role was created. The value of the provider will be in the form of a LOV.

columns.name: CURRENT_IDP_CD
columns.description: Name of the Current Identity Provider where this self service role resides. The value of the provider will be in the form of a LOV.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: START_DATE will be stamped when a role is created.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: END_DATE  will be stamped when a role is deleted from DB. Delete role is soft delete here.

columns.name: DELETE_FLAG
columns.description: DELETE_FLAG will store the value of whether roles deleted (also called as soft delete)

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
